'''Gambling droids''' were [[Droid/Legends|droids]] specifically designed to assist individuals to [[Gambling/Legends|gamble]]. The [[Model GDA-8 Gambling Droid]] manufactured by [[Droxian Manufacturing]] was representative of this droid type.
